text:
mira: Quick note from the v4-lite onboarding AB: MRR flat (+0.2%) but longdoc p99 spiked ~90ms and cost/token +9%. I don't want to promote on MRR alone anymore.
owen: +1. agree. propose multimetric gate: composite = w_m*mrr_norm - w_l*p99_norm - w_c*cost_norm. require composite > T and all individual soft thresholds not exceeded.
samir: we should prefer relative thresholds for latency (pct change) and absolute for halluc rate. else tiny baselines cause flips.
leah: add auto-rollback: (1) p99_pct_change > 0.25 sustained 10m OR (2) halluc_ratio > 1.8 for 5m -> immediate rollback + alert paging.
rollout-bot: /ab-eval run --variant=v4-lite-q --slice=longdocs --dur=2h -> mrr:+0.2%, p99:+90ms, cost:+9%, halluc:+0.4%
owen: Recommendation: w_m=0.6 w_l=0.3 w_c=0.1, T=0.012, deadband=0.006. staged ramp 5%->20%->60% with confirmation windows.
mira: I'll open PR with config + simulation of the AB trace to tune weights. tagging @samir for normalization impl.
leah: ensure rollout traces log which metric blocked promotion. :eyes:
